Put your panel logo images in this folder.

Recommended filename format:
trex-iptv.webp
8k-strong.webp
ultra-8k-ott.webp
dino-iptv.webp
lion-ott.webp
nexon-iptv.webp
tivione.webp
eagle-iptv.webp
mega-ott.webp
crystal-ott.webp
magnum-golden-ott.webp
infinity-iptv.webp
max-ott.webp
dream-4k-iptv.webp
promax-4k-ott.webp

Recommended: square WebP or PNG, exactly 512 x 512 pixels (minimum 256 x 256), transparent background when possible.

Current supplied files use their original format to preserve the source artwork:
8k Strong is WebP and the remaining supplied logos are PNG.
